title: Pacto dev-world secret sidecar
description: Materialized signing material for the cast described by a world-state manifest. Never committed: written mode 0600 beside the manifest and ignored by Git. Keys here are public by construction anyway (the recipe is committed), but they are kept out of the manifest so no consumer is tempted to pass one around as ordinary world data.

manifestVersion.description: Must equal the manifestVersion of the manifest this sidecar accompanies. A mismatch means the pair was generated by two different recipes and is refused.

recipe.description: Recipe id these secrets were derived from. Must match the manifest's recipe id.

identities.description: One entry per persona in the manifest, in the same order.

name.description: Persona name; joins this entry to its manifest persona.

nsec.description: Bech32 Nostr secret key. Feeds pacto-bot-api.toml identities and pacto-app's headless login.

ethPrivateKey.description: The same 32 bytes as the nsec, hex-encoded, per the nostr-k-derivs scheme.

sandboxOnly.description: Always true, mirroring the manifest stamp so a consumer reading only the sidecar still learns the identity is sandbox-only.
